text.title: Readiness Checklist Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact this methodology produces: `features/in-progress/F0NN-slug/readiness.md`, ten binary items each ticked with linked evidence, and the verdict that moves the feature to done/. The JSON Schema below is the machine-checkable view of that file; the subagent MUST satisfy it before returning to the caller.

required.field: `features/in-progress/F0NN-slug/readiness.md`; becomes the last artefact in done/
exactly 10 entries, n=1..10 in order; each with `applies`, `ticked`, and `evidence` when ticked or `reason` when not applicable
`done` only when every applicable item is ticked; otherwise `blocked`
the reviewer (or main thread acting as reviewer) who ticked the boxes

forbidden.pattern: an item ticked with no evidence link next to the checkbox
item 5, 6 or 7 marked not-applicable without a reason naming what the feature does not touch
item 8 unticked without a "no spec impact" statement and a one-line reason
item 9 ticked without naming the surfaces that were grepped
verdict = done while any applicable item is unticked
fewer or more than 10 items, or items out of order

allowed-transformations.transformation: Mark items 5, 6, 7 not-applicable when the git diff activates none of their conditions, recording the reason.
Replace item 8's spec delta with an explicit "no spec impact" statement plus a one-line reason.
Record an intentional, disambiguated surface collision under item 9 instead of "no collision".

output-contract.example: { "feature_id": "F012", "path": "features/in-progress/F012-billing-export/readiness.md", "reviewer": "main-thread", "verdict": "blocked", "items": [ {"n": 1, "title": "ACs evidence", "applies": true, "ticked": true, "evidence": ["tests/api/test_export.py::test_csv_columns", "screenshots/F012-export-success.png"]}, {"n": 2, "title": "tasks done", "applies": true, "ticked": true, "evidence": ["features/in-progress/F012-billing-export/tasks/done/"]}, {"n": 3, "title": "commit hygiene", "applies": true, "ticked": true, "evidence": ["git log --oneline main..F012"]}, {"n": 4, "title": "CI green", "applies": true, "ticked": true, "evidence": ["https://ci.example.com/runs/4471"]}, {"n": 5, "title": "API tests", "applies": true, "ticked": true, "evidence": ["https://ci.example.com/runs/4471#pytest-apps-billing-tests-api"]}, {"n": 6, "title": "Playwright pos+neg", "applies": false, "ticked": false, "reason": "no user-facing flow: export is triggered by an existing button, no new page or form"}, {"n": 7, "title": "UI heuristics", "applies": false, "ticked": false, "reason": "no UI impact: no rendered element changed"}, {"n": 8, "title": "spec delta", "applies": true, "ticked": true, "evidence": ["project-spec/api.md#billing-export (same PR)"]}, {"n": 9, "title": "surface coupling", "applies": true, "ticked": true, "evidence": ["grep 'path: /billing' project-spec/api.md — sibling /billing/invoices, no overlap"]}, {"n": 10, "title": "deployed", "applies": true, "ticked": false} ] }

list.item: Ten items, in order, each a binary checkbox with a linked evidence artefact when ticked
Items 5, 6, 7: applicability derived from the git diff and stated, never waived silently
Item 8 carries the spec delta or the loud "no spec impact" escape hatch with a reason
Item 9 names what was grepped, not just the conclusion
Verdict is done only when no applicable box is empty; readiness.md is then the last artefact in done/

text.reference: Stack-to-gate matrix; consumed when computing which items apply.
